title: quda ka wali mera moula ali
body:
quda ka wali mera moula ali
nabi ka wasi mera moula ali
<<DIVIDER>>
armaan bar aaye jab to na kyu dil ko ho suroor
aankhou ka ho qusoor to husn ka qusoor
jalwe dikha rahi hai tajalli barqe noor
moosa hai ghash me kehta hai chilla ke kohe toor
<<DIVIDER>>
are ye wahi mera moula ali hai
quda ka wali mera moula ali hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ek aan me faqeer ko sulta'n bana diya
ek baat me wahoosh ko insa'n bana diya
zarre ko aaftabe daraqsha'n bana diya
saail ko wo diya ke musalmaa'n bana diya
<<DIVIDER>>
wo dil ka ghani mera moula ali hai
quda wa wali mera moula ali hai
<<DIVIDER>>
shahed hai kis ke amre wilayat pe innama
quraan kis ke shaan me kehta hai qul kafa
kya shad o mad hai dekhiye balagh ko to zara

<<DIVIDER>>
wali wo wali mera moula ali hai
quda ka wali mera moula ali hai

faqou ka apne bachou ke mutlaq nahi malaal

<<DIVIDER>>
saqi wo saqi mera moula ali hai

<<DIVIDER>>
wo naqshe jali mera moula ali hai
quda ka wali mera moula ali hai

allah ka jamaal hai chehre se aashkaar
roushan nazar se haibate qallaqe kirdegaar

<<DIVIDER>>
wo dil ka jari mera moula ali hai

milta hai husne faiz teri aan ke nisaar

<<DIVIDER>>
wo aali ali mera moula ali hai
